description: This Java class 'ProductStoreSurveyWrapper' extends 'SurveyWrapper' and manages survey-related operations within the context of a product store in the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles survey templates, rendering, and response states.

classes.name: ProductStoreSurveyWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for handling product store survey logic, extending the SurveyWrapper to include application-specific survey templates and rendering logic.

methods.name: ProductStoreSurveyWrapper
methods.description: Constructs a new wrapper instance with survey application data, participant info, and pass-through parameters.

methods.name: callResult
methods.description: Sets whether the survey call resulted in a response that should be rendered differently.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns a Writer object to render either the survey form or the results based on the current state.
